title: Sources: SpaceX is currently targeting an IPO valuation of at least $1.8T, down from a previous $2T+ target, after consultations with advisers and investors (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: SpaceX is currently targeting an IPO valuation of at least $1.8T, down from a previous $2T+ target, after consultations with advisers and investors — SpaceX is currently targeting a valuation of at least $1.8 trillion in its initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter …
